page: Microsoft Azure DC32ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the DCadsv6 server family. It is powered by an AMD processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture, delivering 32 dedicated vCPUs. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, which translates to a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This hardware configuration operates on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, ensuring dedicated compute resource allocation without CPU sharing.

For local storage requirements, the DC32ads_v6 includes a bundled 1229 GB local SSD. Additionally, the instance is Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with external storage volumes. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this server type. There are no integrated GPUs, making this instance unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or GPU-based machine learning workloads.

With its 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and substantial local SSD capacity, the DC32ads_v6 offers a balanced resource profile. This makes it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for workloads requiring a mix of compute, memory, and fast local temporary storage without the premium cost of memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated hardware. Suitable workloads include relational databases, enterprise applications, web serving, and general-purpose development or build environments.
